# seeded-maze

> Deterministic, engine-agnostic maze generation: seeded grid mazes, rail-node geometry, curved-wall
> outlines, and multi-layer mazes with a solvability proof. Plain data in and out; ESM and CommonJS;
> one dependency (seedrandom).

## Docs

- [Documentation site](https://jonbogaty.com/seeded-maze/): the published, browsable version of
  everything below.
- [README](https://github.com/jbcom/seeded-maze/blob/main/README.md): install, quick start, API overview.
- [API reference](https://github.com/jbcom/seeded-maze/blob/main/docs/API.md): signatures and behavior
  for every export.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/jbcom/seeded-maze/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): module
  boundaries, invariants, the seed contract, intentional limits.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/jbcom/seeded-maze/blob/main/AGENTS.md): toolchain, invariants not to
  violate, and doc/test sync obligations for an autonomous coding agent working in this repository.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/jbcom/seeded-maze/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): local setup, the
  `pnpm verify` gate, commit and release conventions.
